# Build and Release Scripts

This layer contains scripts used for building, packaging, and releasing the software project.

## Overview

It includes scripts for generating version information, building documentation, packaging the software, and handling the release process.

## How it works

- `build-node.js`: Sets up the build environment and installs Cairo on your machine.
- `build-version.js`: Generates version information, including the version date, commit hash, and commit date.
- `buildDocs.js`: Builds the documentation for the project.
- `buildPackage.js`: Packages the software for distribution, resolving relative paths and precompiling assets.
- `release.js`: Manages the release process, validating the package name and updating the changelog.
- `updateChangelog.js`: Updates the changelog based on the latest commits since the last release.

In the `woff2` subfolder, the scripts handle the building and serving of WOFF2 fonts using ESBuild and Vite.
